_about: Icon gate thresholds (py/gates.py; docs/ART.md s5/s10). default applies to every collection; collections override. Values: corner/ring = max alpha 0-255, dup = max 24x24 luma correlation, fill = long side of the alpha box / canvas, lumaFloor / valueFloor = interior mean luma / HSV value 0-255 (fails only when both are below), glyphContrast = |glyph - ground| luma 0-255, huePerBand = max icons per 40 degree hue band (0 = off).
